rule: Routes of administration split and upper-cased

rule: Exclusive groups: inhaled takes precedence over oral
reason: A molecule with inhaled products goes into the inhaled group (also_oral = 1 if it also exists as an oral product); the oral group contains only molecules that are never inhaled.

Molecular weight below 100 Da or ATC V03AN (oxygen, nitrogen, nitrous oxide...): not designed drugs.
All ATC codes are V04/V08/V09 (challenge tests, contrast agents, radiopharmaceuticals).

rule: Inhaled drugs acting systemically on the nervous system
reason: First-level ATC N (volatile anaesthetics, loxapine, levodopa): they are inhaled to reach the blood, the opposite of a drug meant to stay in the lung.

rule: Oral drugs acting locally in the gut
reason: All ATC codes are A06/A07 (laxatives, intestinal anti-infectives and anti-inflammatories): they are designed not to be absorbed, so they do not represent systemic oral drugs.
